experiment_data.hypothesis: G-MFRM 各组件（continuous gating, judge severity d_j, joint estimation）对性能的独立贡献，合成数据消融

spec.command: python run_ablation.py (binary vs continuous gating, with/without d_j, joint vs staged, 20 seeds)
spec.data_path: synthetic (mvp_003 DGP: N=50, J=8, I=100, rho=0.6)
spec.eval_data: synthetic DGP (N=50, J=8, I=100, rho=0.6, c~HalfNormal(1.5))

experiment_data.notes: 初步结果(2/20 seeds): full_gmfrm θ_RMSE=0.124/0.151, τ=0.922/0.920 | binary_gating c_RMSE +75% | no_judge_severity θ接近full | staged_estimation 最差(θ_RMSE 2.4x, c_RMSE 3.4x). 单seed ~19min, 20 seeds ETA ~6.3h. tmux session: w7_ablation
